what: Range switching on the Tool Insights page does not refresh report-derived values (D6), on build rev 5941f89424ac where reportQuery('all') = { range: 'all' } is present.
network: Clicking 24h caused 0 observable network requests (Network.requestWillBeSent) and no new WebSocket frames; the label changes only.
finding: The page fetches the report once for the initial range and never applies a new report for 24h/30d/All even though the range label and the KPI suffix update. reportQuery is correct in this build (all -> { range: 'all' }); the defect is the range->fetch/apply wiring (effect not rerunning, or its result not reaching deriveInsights).
codeMode: The provided 64c910b6 session's 14 tool_mode_run calls are still outside the newest-200 retained window: with only that session plus e9ccb118/496d3f53 and the four anti-slop sessions, the host report recentCalls (200) contains zero tool_mode_run/run_code rows (all report: 2,448 calls / 5 sessions / 43 tools).
